new_items.title: Acme Protocol pauses withdrawals after a $12 million exploit
new_items.summary: Acme Protocol has paused withdrawals after attackers drained $12 million from its lending pools on November 8. The team said it is investigating and that users cannot withdraw while the pause is in place.
